title: The 10-page edition has its three yeses back
headline: Round 1 of the edits ran overnight. The storyteller changed the words, the publisher rebuilt both editions at 06:50 and the designer redrew cover A on the signed title. In round 2 the same three test readers read the rebuilt PDFs, and all three would start tomorrow from the 10-page edition again, up from three maybes. What is still wrong is mostly the look. The pictures are dashed 'Figure to come' boxes, the failures page is two-thirds blank, and cover A and the speakers' heads are drawn but not yet placed on the pages. One small wording choice needs you (RL1). The final editions come once these edits are in.

sections.title: Since brief 37
items: storyteller: both scripts edited from synthetic's, the designer's and the writer's letters. There is now a promise line under the subtitle, 'The stop at 18:44' says plainly what happened, and the shared brief, board and hold come first on the team page (storyteller__046).

publisher: rebuilt both editions (publisher__026). The contents page is gone, the promise prints on the title page and the series page is at the back (SP1). It also carved manuscript/rc2/ out for the writer (publisher__027).
designer: cover A on the signed title, an on-stage marker for each scene page and a head before every speaker, all sent to the publisher to place (designer__071, 073).
writer: read both editions against your voice and sent nine points (writer__002); the storyteller took them all except the running line, which is RL1.

synthetic: round 2 read. The 10-page edition is back to three yeses. The remaining asks: draw the four figures, fill the failures page (page 8), give the sources as plain names, and lighten the running head.

sections.title: Still to come in ED1
items: The designer's drawings placed and the four figures drawn; the storyteller's round-2 words (the misses named on page 8, the team of several brought forward); the publisher's rebuild.

Then the researcher's trace of every number, security's clearance and a last read, and the final editions to you. Not yet heard: ruv-sgit, the researcher, the historian, the librarian, security and the developer.
